recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: agents inheriting team coding standards through shared skill files
shipping lanes whispering open after long closure
rescue boats cutting through morning fog in the channel
august fog burning off by noon over the bay
sixteen degrees and mostly clear before the afternoon warm-up

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Swipe between rooftop lanes catching golden sunrise streaks as Karl the fog retreats across San Francisco; missed light thickens the mist and dims the view.
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: each round ends with a sunrise snapshot score — how much sky you cleared before the timer runs out
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: fog rolls back faster, lanes narrow, streaks split into pairs you must grab in sequence
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: watercolor bay morning, soft orange gradients bleeding into grey fog banks

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Flick skill-file shards into orbiting agent slots on a phone screen; wrong slot rejects the shard and it shatters, scattering standards everywhere.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: load a complete team standards kit before the agent queue fills — one clean rack feels like shipping by sunrise
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: slots spin faster, shard types multiply, decoy fragments mimic real skills
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: neon terminal wireframe on dark glass, shards as glowing markdown fragments

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Hold to charge cargo weight, release to launch through a narrowing strait gap; under-shoot stalls, over-shoot crashes on the far bank.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: one perfect launch through the gap on the last second feels like beating the tide
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: strait width pulses with the swell, crosswinds tug mid-flight, cargo types change mass
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: paper cutout nautical charts, torn edges, ink-wash sea

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Rhythm-tap when parallel agent nodes light up in sequence; missed beats spawn duplicate brains that clog the lane and desync the chorus.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: finishing a clean 16-beat chain unlocks a synchronized commit burst — same chat, different brains in harmony
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: polyrhythm layers stack, decoy nodes flash off-beat, the lane compresses
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: lo-fi oscilloscope hearts on cream background, nodes as pulsing chat bubbles
